title: new-hires
text:
new-hires

Olivia Park: hey y'all! Olivia here — thrilled to join Redwood as a product manager for infra. Moved up from Montreal last week. I make quesadillas that are dangerously good :taco: and i'm obsessed with ceramics. Excited to meet folks! Quick qs: who's the contact for parking passes? and what t-shirt sizes do we collect for swag? :wave:
Sam Pizza: welcome Olivia!! :tada: Quesadillas > pizza. For parking ping @People Ops, but most folks do permit app. T-shirt size?
Avery Li: omg welcome! i'm S. also where's the best coffee in the office? need recs for ceramic studio.
Noor Khan: hi Olivia! i'm M. Parking handled by People Ops — @People Ops will DM you the form. Also we have a weekly ceramics club apparently :eyes: 
Juno Rivera: Olivia!! can't wait to try your quesadillas :yum: I'm L for shirt. Desk assignment is in #office-layout but shout if you want a sunny spot.
People Ops: Hi Olivia — welcome! Parking pass request form: https://redwood.internal/parking. Please fill out the form and we'll follow up. Also let us know your t-shirt size.
Olivia Park: thanks all!! i'll put M in the form. does anyone bring snacks Friday mornings? happy to bring quesadillas on my first Friday :sweat_smile:
Sam Pizza: YES please. Also FYI fridge has a sticky note system for shared snacks :fridge: 
Avery Li: coffee rec — grab an americano from the 3rd floor machine, ask Evan for the secret syrup :stuck_out_tongue:
Noor Khan: fyi onboarding lunch tomorrow at noon in the kitchen — bring whatever you want to share.
Juno Rivera: added you to the new-hires lunch calendar invite. also, you're on ceramics club waitlist, we'll ping when there's a slot.
Olivia Park: amazing, thanks! feel free to roast my quesadilla recipe — i'm learning :chef:
Devex Bot: new member Olivia Park added to #new-hires :party_parrot:
Sam Pizza: welcome again, Olivia. :sparkles:
